title: Author simple Go unit tests for ProjHub MCP security and product-regression behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: Call ping_team_server with shell-style payloads and assert no execution artifacts like uid= or gid= appear, along with a benign control case.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevents command injection while allowing safe usage.

ground_truth_issues.description: Ensure internal comments are hidden while public comments remain visible for user-key.
Ensure non-admin users cannot see admin/internal project fields while admin users can.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures sensitive fields are properly restricted.

ground_truth_issues.description: Initialize the MCP server using NewServer and assert it is not nil and does not error.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures the MCP server initializes correctly.

ground_truth_issues.description: Ensure unsafe module names are rejected and safe modules like json are accepted.
Ensure user-key cannot access project-beta but can access project-alpha.
Ensure user-key cannot update task-beta or see beta reviewer markers.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevents cross-team task mutation and metadata exposure.

ground_truth_issues.description: Ensure a deleted task no longer appears in search results for its title.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures deleted tasks are removed from discovery.

ground_truth_issues.description: Ensure user-key search can find alpha tasks but user2-key cannot find the same alpha task query.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures task search results stay within team boundaries.

ground_truth_issues.description: Ensure internal URLs do not leak metadata and public URLs return expected content.
Ensure diagnostic endpoints do not expose sensitive secrets.
Ensure tests are independent and reproducible.
Ensure tests use proper assertions and captured values.
